mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_invoice_number (invoice_type, invoice_code, start_no, end_no, current_no, total_count, used_count, remaining_count, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{invoiceType}, #{invoiceCode}, #{startNo}, #{endNo}, #{currentNo}, #{totalCount}, #{usedCount}, #{remainingCount}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_invoice_number SET invoice_type = #{invoiceType}, invoice_code = #{invoiceCode}, start_no = #{startNo}, end_no = #{endNo}, current_no = #{currentNo}, total_count = #{totalCount}, used_count = #{usedCount}, remaining_count = #{remainingCount}, status = #{status}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_invoice_number WHERE invoice_type = #{invoiceType} ORDER BY id
SELECT * FROM t_invoice_number WHERE invoice_type = #{invoiceType} AND status = 'active' AND remaining_count > 0 ORDER BY id
SELECT * FROM t_invoice_number WHERE invoice_type = #{invoiceType} AND status = 'active' AND remaining_count > 0 ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE t_invoice_number SET used_count = #{usedCount}, remaining_count = #{remainingCount}, current_no = #{currentNo}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
